when_to_use: The customer is trying to switch roaming on, for example before or at the start of a trip, and it will not activate. If they are already abroad and the phone shows no signal, use PROC-014.

steps.description: Check if roaming is disabled on the account
Check if customer's plan is inactive
Check if the device does not support the destination's roaming bands

when_to_use: The customer disputes roaming charges already billed to them after using their phone abroad. For a charge on the invoice that is not about roaming, use PROC-003 or PROC-004.

steps.description: Check if outstanding balance exceeds $50
Check if payment method is prepaid
Check if customer has an unresolved prior ticket on this issue

when_to_use: The customer's monthly bill is higher than expected or shows a charge they do not recognise, without naming one specific line item to contest. If they name one line item and want it corrected or refunded, use PROC-004; for roaming charges use PROC-002; for a charge they think is fraud use PROC-009.

steps.description: Check if outstanding balance exceeds $50
Check if last payment attempt failed
Check if account is suspended

procedure_name: Customer disputes a specific billing line item
when_to_use: The customer contests one specific line item on their bill and wants it corrected, refunded or credited. For a general 'my bill is higher than usual', use PROC-003.

steps.description: Check if account balance is zero
Check if payment method is bank transfer
Check if the customer's ticket description specifically requests a refund or credit

when_to_use: The customer's service or account has been suspended or cut off because of a missed or failed payment. For being unable to log in to the online account, use PROC-018.

steps.description: Check if account is suspended
Check if last payment attempt failed
Check if account is closed

procedure_name: SIM card not recognized by device
when_to_use: The customer's phone does not detect or accept their current SIM card ('No SIM', 'invalid SIM'). If they are asking for a new SIM because it was lost, stolen or damaged, use PROC-007.

steps.description: Check if SIM status is blocked
Check if SIM status is not activated
Check if SIM status is otherwise active but device still fails

when_to_use: The customer asks for a new or replacement SIM card: lost, stolen, damaged, or a different size. If the current SIM is simply not detected by the phone, use PROC-006.

steps.description: Check if SIM status is blocked
Check if account is suspended

when_to_use: The customer's recurring or automatic payment keeps failing or being declined. For one charge they think is fraudulent, use PROC-009; if the account is already suspended for non-payment, use PROC-005.

steps.description: Check if last payment attempt failed
Check if payment method is prepaid
Check if last payment is still pending
Check if customer has multiple unresolved tickets suggesting fraud

when_to_use: The customer reports a charge or payment they did not make or authorise and suspects fraud. If the concern is someone getting into or changing the account rather than a payment, use PROC-019.

steps.description: Check if the payment gateway flags this account as high fraud risk
Check if last payment attempt failed

when_to_use: A prepaid customer's balance or credit ran out faster than expected or disappeared. For charges on a postpaid monthly bill, use PROC-003.

steps.description: Check if payment method is prepaid
Check if account balance is zero
Check if customer has an unresolved billing ticket

procedure_name: Customer wants to change data plan
when_to_use: The customer wants to upgrade, downgrade or switch their data or mobile plan. If they already ordered a new plan and it has not started, use PROC-012.

steps.description: Check if plan status is inactive
Check if last payment is still pending
Check if tenure is 24+ months (loyalty eligible)

when_to_use: The customer ordered or switched to a new plan and it has not become active yet. If they want to make a plan change in the first place, use PROC-011.

steps.description: Check if plan status is pending
Check if last payment attempt failed
Check if tenure is under 3 months (new customer onboarding issue)

when_to_use: The customer wants to cancel their contract or close their account now, and the consultant is handling that request. A question about cancellation fees or terms with no cancellation being made is not this procedure.

steps.description: Check if customer still owes an outstanding device installment balance (IMEI -> financing lookup)
Check if account balance is zero
Check if outstanding balance exceeds $50
Check if tenure is 24+ months (waiver eligible)

procedure_name: Device shows no roaming bars abroad
when_to_use: The customer is abroad and their phone shows no signal, no bars or 'emergency calls only'. If they cannot switch roaming on in the first place, use PROC-001.

steps.description: Check if the device does not support the destination's roaming bands
Check if roaming is disabled on the account
Confirm the device is roaming-compatible, then advise a carrier settings update

when_to_use: The customer's device stopped working properly (crashes, lost service, broken features) after a software or firmware update. For a SIM not being detected with no update involved, use PROC-006.

steps.description: Check device roaming compatibility to rule out a roaming-specific issue
Check if SIM status is active

procedure_name: Reported service outage in customer's area
when_to_use: The customer reports no service, dropped calls or no mobile data where they are, possibly a network outage in their area. If they are asking for a credit or compensation for an outage, use PROC-017.

steps.description: Check for a confirmed active network outage in the customer's service area (ZIP lookup, then outage-by-ZIP check)
Check if SIM status is active
Check if account is suspended (rule out account-side cause)

procedure_name: Customer requests service credit for outage
when_to_use: The customer asks for a bill credit or compensation because of a service outage. For reporting that service is down right now, use PROC-016.

steps.description: Check if the customer's most recent ticket description indicates the outage issue is still ongoing
Check if outstanding balance exceeds $50

procedure_name: Customer locked out of online account
when_to_use: The customer cannot log in to their online account or app: locked out, forgotten password, or locked after failed attempts. If they already reset the password and the app still fails, use PROC-020; if they think someone else got into the account, use PROC-019.

steps.description: Verify customer identity before any account changes
Check if account is suspended
Check if account is closed

when_to_use: The customer believes someone else accessed or changed their account: unknown logins, details changed, or a SIM swap they did not ask for. For a fraudulent payment or charge, use PROC-009.

steps.description: Check if the customer's ticket description suggests unauthorized or suspicious activity
Check if last payment attempt failed (possible fraud indicator)

procedure_name: Login app repeatedly fails after password reset
when_to_use: The customer already reset their password but logging in to the app still fails repeatedly. If they cannot log in and have not reset the password, use PROC-018.

steps.description: Direct customer to clear cached app data and retry login
Check if account is suspended
Check if SIM status is active (rule out device-side 2FA delivery issue)
